_note: Benchmark tasks. 'stable' tasks have answers fixed by past filings (gold facts checked against the issuers' own releases on 2026-10-11). 'live' tasks depend on current reporting; they are graded for coverage and grounding only. `key_facts` and `coverage` are case-insensitive regular expressions matched against the final answer; a fact counts as found when any of its patterns matches. Both GAAP and non-GAAP figures are accepted where a company reports both.
